Pest Control Services

Safe, effective, and compliant pest management solutions to maintain hygienic and pest-free commercial environments year-round.

Hygiene & Safety

Pest Control Services

Pest infestations damage reputation, violate compliance standards, and disrupt operations. Our IPM-based approach prevents infestations before they happen — and resolves them fast when they do, with full documentation for every treatment.

Get a proposal →
What We Do
Our Pest Control Services Services
01
Integrated Pest Management (IPM) Solutions

Science-based IPM methodology that combines preventive, monitoring, and corrective interventions — minimising chemical use while maximising effectiveness.

02
Customised Treatment Plans

No two facilities are alike. We design site-specific treatment plans based on pest risk profile, facility type, and occupancy patterns.

03
Preventive & Corrective Pest Control

Scheduled preventive treatments with AMC contracts, plus rapid-response corrective interventions when infestations are detected.

04
Compliance, Documentation & Reporting

WHO and CIB-approved products. Treatment certificates issued after every visit — audit-ready for FSSAI, NABH, or any regulatory inspection.

How It Works
Our Process
01
Inspect

Thorough site inspection to assess pest risk, infestation level, and entry points.

02
Plan

Custom treatment plan with product selection, schedule, and safety protocols.

03
Treat

Professional treatment by certified technicians with all safety precautions.

04
Certify

Issuance of treatment certificate and scheduling of follow-up or AMC visits.
